Posting on Airbnb's Greenhouse job board (token airbnb): Advanced Analytics Intern, United States.
The posting says: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. . The Community You Will Join: . Airbnb is seeking an Advanced Analytics Intern to join the Finance Data Science & Strategy team within the Finance organization for the 2027 Summer Intern Program. The Finance Data Science & Strategy team builds the statistical models behind Airbnb’s top line forecast and explains how the business performs against it. The work runs as a loop. We figure out where actuals differ from forecast and why, share the answer with partners across Finance and the business, and feed what we learned into the next version of the forecast, so each cycle starts from a better baseline than the last. We are looking for someone curious about business and data, who can understand both the ‘what’ and the ‘why’ behind a number and help translate them into decisions. An ideal candidate would have some familiarity with analytical methodologies, BI tooling, and business communication. . The Difference You Will Make: . As an Advanced Analytics Intern on our team, you’ll help explain how the business performed against the forecast and use what you find to improve it. You’ll have the opportunity to:. Build comprehensive and high quality analyses of how the business is performing against the forecast, and explain what drove the difference. Work with the team’s data scientists to turn those findings into improvements in the next version of the forecast. Communicate findings clearly to partners across Finance and the business, in written readouts and recurring reviews. A Typical Day: . During your internship you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during the summer. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our business, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You’ll be expected to:. Own and complete a capstone project from beginning to end. Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones. Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates. Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship. Actively participate in and contribute to the Finance Data Science & Strategy team and broader Airbnb community. Your Expertise: . This opportunity is for full-time students completing a Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Data Science, Mathematics, Analytics, Statistics, Econometrics, etc.) with at least one semester of school remaining after the internship. Proficient in communication and collaboration, with the ability to effectively engage with diverse teams and individuals. Skilled in conducting thorough and inclusive analyses, ensuring that findings are communicated clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Possesses robust data, statistical analysis, and analytics skills, contributing to a comprehensive understanding of complex datasets. Substantial experience in SQL, along with a solid foundation in at least one programming language (Python or R). Preferred (not required): Familiarity with forecasting, time series, and/or A/B testing. Demonstrated interest in high growth, technology, and/or hospitality companies. Work authorization for employment in the United States is required (CPT/OPT with 2-year STEM extension is accepted). Your Location: . This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. . Equal Employment Opportunity :. Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How we’ll take care of you: . Our job titles may span more than one career or degree level. This role may also be eligible for benefits and Employee Travel Credits. . Pay Range. $40 — $40 USD.. Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. Posting on Airbnb's Greenhouse job board (token airbnb): Lead Advanced Analytics, Community Support, Bengaluru, India.
The posting says: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. . The Community You Will Join . The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data-driven decision-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world-class analytics organization that provides scalable analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales,social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnership & economics. The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data-driven decisions. This includes a one-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, experimentation, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing. The Difference You Will Make . ACOE is seeking a Lead, Advanced Analytics, Community Support to help Airbnb enable travel for millions of guests and hosts on our platform. This individual will play a pivotal role in supporting strategic business and product initiatives through detailed data analysis, metrics creation, statistical modeling, and the development of reporting tools and metrics. The individual will be instrumental in driving business and product decisions across topic areas across the company. A Typical Day . Design and build metrics / dimensions to monitor product and business performance. Build sophisticated reporting, analytical tools, and dashboards that empower stakeholders to make data-driven decisions. Work cross-functionally with Strategic Finance, Data and Analytical Engineering,and Data Science teams to ensure alignment and leverage synergies. Conduct advanced data analysis and statistical modeling to extract actionable insights that inform strategic decisions. Contribute towards advancing the Analytics and Data Science disciplines at Airbnb, including driving data best practices such as improving and automating analytical processes, building new data tools and data sets, data education around the company and mentoring and developing others. Actively build and scale AI-first analytics capabilities by integrating LLMs, agent-based workflows, and automation into day-to-day analytical processes. Drive adoption of AI tools across teams by embedding them into business workflows, enabling self-serve analytics and decision support. Stay at the forefront of applied AI developments and continuously evaluate their relevance for solving business problems. Your Expertise . 8+ years in industry experience and a degree (Masters or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research). Prior experience in data science, product analytics within the community support/customer support domain. Deep expertise in measurement frameworks, metric design, and metric creation. Advanced level proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, programming languages such as Python, R, SAS and Intermediate level knowledge of data foundations and databases like Presto, Hive, Teradata, Spark. Expert with BI tools like Tableau or superset to develop reports and dashboards. Experience leveraging AI to build dashboards, automate repetitive tasks, and empower stakeholders. Familiar with experimentation, causal inference, and LLMs. Robust business acumen, strategic thinking skills, and the ability to make informed judgments. Outstanding communication skills, capable of engaging with a variety of stakeholders and conveying complex concepts in an accessible manner. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and influence across functions. An agile, growth-minded approach, demonstrated through a history of driving projects from ideation to impact. How We'll Take Care of You: . Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. . India Annual Pay Range. ₹3,080,000 — ₹4,400,000 INR.. Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.
